[1/3] Add a local pre-push guard so raw git pushes fail outside aikit publish

impact_assessment.why: A raw gh repo create push bypassed AIKit's media, license, topic, dossier and gate sequence; a project guideline is not enforcement.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every new, attached or published project gets a .git/hooks/pre-push guard; only aikit publish sets AIKIT_PUBLISH=1 for its own push subprocess.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: publish/new/attach install a local hook; dependency: none (POSIX sh is supplied by Git); concurrency: existing foreign hooks preserved as pre-push.local; state: .git/hooks only, no tracked project files
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit tests cover installation, environment restore and existing-hook preservation; integration test executes the hook under sh; full AIKit gates and dogfood.
